jobs.description:
Job title: Senior QA Automation Engineer (Playwright with Python)


Experience: 57 years


Location: Hyderabad


Employment type: contract


About the role:


We are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable test automation for our web applications and APIs using Playwright with Python. You will own the automation framework, drive quality practices across agile teams, and integrate testing into our CI/CD pipelines to enable fast, reliable releases.


Key responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain a robust UI and API automation framework using Playwright (Python) and pytest, following Page Object Model and clean-code principles.


Translate business requirements and user stories into test scenarios, test cases, and automated scripts.


Build and maintain regression, smoke, and end-to-end test suites across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.


Automate REST API testing using Playwright's request context and/or the requests library, including schema and data validation.


Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps) with parallel execution and environment-based configuration.


Analyze test failures using traces, screenshots, videos, and logs; reduce flaky tests and improve suite stability.Produce clear test reports (Allure or pytest-html) and communicate quality status to stakeholders.


Participate in sprint planning, story grooming, and code reviews; advocate shift-left testing with developers.


Mentor junior QA engineers and contribute to test strategy, standards, and best practices.


Evaluate and introduce tools that improve test coverage, speed, and reliability.


Required skills and qualifications 57 years of experience in software quality assurance, with at least 4 years in test automation.


2+ years of hands-on experience with Playwright using Python.


Strong Python programming skills, including OOP, fixtures, decorators, and exception handling.


Solid experience with pytest (fixtures, parametrization, markers, plugins such as pytest-xdist).


Proven experience designing automation frameworks from scratch using Page Object Model or similar patterns.


Experience in API testing (REST, JSON, authentication tokens) and tools such as Postman.


Working knowledge of CI/CD tools and Git-based version control.


Good understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, DOM, and browser developer tools.


Experience with SQL for backend data validation.


Familiarity with Agile/Scrum and defect-tracking tools (Jira, Azure Boards).Strong analytical, debugging, and communication skills.


Good to have


Experience migrating tests from Selenium or Cypress to Playwright.


Docker and cloud-based test execution (BrowserStack, LambdaTest, or Playwright on Kubernetes).


Performance testing exposure (JMeter, Locust, k6).


Accessibility and visual regression testing.


BDD frameworks such as pytest-bdd or Behave.


ISTQB or equivalent certification.


Compensation: 1,500,000.00 - 2,000,000.00 per year


Benefits:



 Flexible schedule
 Internet reimbursement
 Paid sick time
 Provident Fund

Experience:



 7years: 7 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person .

jobs.job_title: Lead I - Software Testing- Playwright with Python Automation (Telangana)
jobs.description:
Role description

We are seeking a highly experienced and motivated Senior QA Automation Engineer with strong expertise in Playwright and Python to join our Quality Engineering team. The ideal candidate will have proven experience in building and maintaining robust automation frameworks, driving end-to-end test strategy, and ensuring high-quality software delivery.

In addition to traditional QA responsibilities, the candidate should have an interest in or exposure to modern AI-enabled testing approaches, including Generative AI and Intelligent Test Automation. This role requires a hands-on professional who can work independently, provide technical guidance, and contribute effectively across both automation and manual testing activities when required.

Key Responsibilities 

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks using Playwright and Python.
- Create and execute automated test cases for functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing.
- Participate in test planning, test execution, defect tracking, and overall QA lifecycle activities.
- Analyse test results, identify defects, and collaborate with development teams to ensure timely resolution.
- Drive testing best practices and provide technical leadership and mentorship when needed.
- Support manual testing activities during project phases where automation is not feasible or practical.
- Continuously improve testing processes, automation coverage, and quality metrics.
- Contribute to the adoption of emerging AI-driven testing methodologies and tools.

Required Skills & Experience 
- Strong hands-on experience in Automation Testing using Playwright and Python.
- Proven experience in designing, developing, and maintaining automation frameworks.
- Solid understanding of: 
- Test Planning
- Test Execution
- Defect Management
- Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC)
- Quality Assurance best practices

- Ability to work independently and take ownership of testing deliverables.
- Experience providing technical guidance and leadership within QA teams.
- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Additional Expectations 
- Flexibility to perform manual testing activities whenever project requirements demand.
- Ability to balance both automation and manual QA responsibilities effectively.
- Robust collaboration skills with cross-functional teams in agile environments.

Skills

Test Automation, Python, Functional Testing, Playwright, Agentic AI, Defect Tracking, Generative AI, Manual Testing

About UST   
UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the worlds best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impacttouching billions of lives in the process. .

jobs.title: Creditsafe - QA Automation Engineer - Playwright/Cypress/Python
jobs.description:
QA Automation Engineer - Playwright / Cypress / Python

About the Role:

We are looking for a skilled and passionate QA Automation Engineer to join our Product Engineering team and help us build high-quality, reliable, and scalable products.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Playwright and/or Cypress, Python, automated testing, API testing, and end-to-end test automation.

You will work closely with Engineering, Product, and other stakeholders to build robust automation solutions, improve product quality, identify potential risks early, and ensure reliable customer experiences across complex and distributed applications.

What You'll Do:

- Design, develop, maintain, and optimize scalable automated testing frameworks.

- Develop end-to-end UI and API automation using Playwright and/or Cypress.

- Build automation utilities and frameworks using Python.

- Develop comprehensive functional, regression, integration, API, and end-to-end test suites.

- Automate critical business workflows and high-value product scenarios.

- Perform manual testing of modern web applications, APIs, backend services, and distributed system workflows.

- Design effective test strategies for complex and scalable applications.

- Identify, troubleshoot, and eliminate flaky tests.

- Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.

- Collaborate closely with Software Engineers to identify defects early and improve product quality.

- Participate in product and technical discussions and proactively identify quality risks.

- Work with Product Managers and stakeholders to understand requirements and communicate product quality and improvement opportunities.

- Perform root-cause analysis for defects and production issues.

- Maintain clean, reusable, scalable, and maintainable automation code.

- Contribute to automation standards, testing practices, and Quality Engineering processes.

- Continuously improve test coverage, automation reliability, and execution efficiency.

- Explore and adopt modern testing tools and methodologies.

- Utilize Generative AI and AI-assisted development tools to improve test creation, automation development, debugging, test-data generation, test coverage, and productivity.

What We're Looking For:

- 3 - 8 years of experience in QA Automation / Software Quality Engineering.

- Strong hands-on experience with Playwright and/or Cypress.

- Good programming experience with Python.

- Experience developing and maintaining automation frameworks.

- Strong understanding of UI, API, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.

- Experience automating complex business workflows.

- Experience with REST API testing.

- Understanding of modern web applications and distributed systems.

- Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.

- Strong understanding of test strategy, test design, coverage, and defect management.

- Familiarity with Git and modern software development practices.

- Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Good to Have:

- Experience testing AWS-based cloud-native applications.

- Experience testing distributed architectures involving APIs, queues, asynchronous processing, databases, and backend services.

- Experience with performance or load testing.

- Experience with test reporting, observability, and test analytics.

- Experience with Docker and cloud-based test environments.

- Exposure to Generative AI, LLMs, AI Agents, or AI/ML technologies.

- Experience using Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar AI-assisted development tools.

- Experience applying AI to test generation, automation optimization, test analysis, or quality engineering.

What You'll Bring:

- Strong individual contributor mindset and ownership of quality.

- Ability to independently design and implement effective automation solutions.

- Strong understanding of complex application architectures and distributed systems.

- Proactive approach to identifying product quality risks and improvement opportunities.

- Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills.

- Focus on building reliable, maintainable, and meaningful automation rather than simply increasing test volume.

- Ability to work effectively with Engineering, Product, and other stakeholders.

- Strong customer and product mindset.

- Willingness to continuously learn and adopt modern QA, automation, and AI technologies.

Why Join Us:

You will work closely with Product and Engineering teams on modern, scalable applications and distributed systems, helping shape the overall quality engineering strategy. You will have opportunities to adopt modern automation technologies and leverage AI and Generative AI to transform testing, automation, and product quality.
